# phare_integration_sms (Resource)

Manages an SMS integration in Phare, sending alerts by text message to organization members with a verified phone number. Requires a Scale plan subscription. Integrations belong to the organization and are used by alert rules to send notifications. [See docs](https://docs.phare.io/integrations/sms).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "phare_users" "on_call" {
  emails = ["alice@example.com", "bob@example.com"]
}

# Requires a Scale plan subscription, members must verify their phone number
resource "phare_integration_sms" "on_call" {
  name = "On-call phones"

  settings = {
    members = data.phare_users.on_call.users[*].id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Integration name, must be unique across all the integrations of the organization
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings of the SMS integration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Date of creation
- `id` (Number) Integration ID
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the integration is paused, integrations can only be paused from the control panel
- `updated_at` (String) Date of last update

<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Required:

- `members` (Set of Number) IDs of the organization members receiving the alerts (1-100), see the `phare_users` data source
